name: Limit / Headroom Tracker
when_to_pick: Track one or more current values against the limits they must respect, with a bar per rule showing how much headroom is left before a breach. Built for prop-firm / funded-account rules (daily-loss limit, max total drawdown, profit target, minimum trading days) but works for any value-vs-threshold read: margin usage, weekly risk budget used, exposure caps. Each row colours by how close it is. Set direction='max' (default) for a ceiling the value must stay UNDER (e.g. daily loss, drawdown), or 'min' for a floor/target it must reach (e.g. profit target, minimum trading days). Pick this when the takeaway is 'how close am I to breaking — or hitting — a rule'; for a single bounded score use gauge_meter.

label.description: Rule name, e.g. 'Daily loss', 'Max drawdown', 'Profit target'.

limit.description: The threshold. Must be > 0 (it is the bar's denominator).

direction.description: 'max' = value must stay UNDER the limit (ceiling, e.g. loss). 'min' = value must reach/exceed the limit (floor/target, e.g. profit).
